$comment: This site's half of the cross-repository contract, and it is data only.
The laws are not here. They are the failure messages of the gates in
`@nanisoft/prism-ui/gates`, which this repository installs by pinning that
package exactly, so a change to a law lands once and reaches this repository
in one release and cannot be declined here. What is here is the set of facts
only this site knows: which stylesheets are its own, how much of them counts
as having read something, which destination its own corpus gets wrong, and
which module owns the arming attribute for the one hidden state this site ships.
A line in this file that stated a rule would be the defect the file exists to
end, because a rule held in five repositories is five rules that will disagree.

supplied.--font-inter: declared by next/font at build time as a class on the document element

knownBroken./docs/data-contract/index: fumadocs routes a folder index at the folder, so this document is at /docs/data-contract. Five published documents link to the guessed path. The corpus is frozen by the migration, so the decision is recorded here rather than made by editing five documents; a change to the corpus can close it and delete this entry in the same commit.
